summary:
Read-only design review complete. HEAD remains `5c2bc526f0ad5b82eaeab244bd82f3af0416a363`; I made no edits and ran no builds, tests, preparation or inference.

1. **Pass the actual loaded TensorRT tuple into admission.**  
   [Libraries](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-2a9e2016/src/common/uct_tensorrt.cpp:201) currently enforces exact equality; [BeginPreparation](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-2a9e2016/src/common/uct_tensorrt.cpp:1161) constructs schema-1 `Device` without an actual runtime version. Root’s seam should retain `nvinfer_11.dll`, collect all four version exports once, enforce the numeric floor, and pass that tuple into policy checks. Do not let a default `"11.4.0.106"` stand in for observation. Test exact minimum, `11.4.0.105` rejection, `11.4.1.0`/`11.5.0.0` admission, and missing exports. Admission must not promise successful deserialization.

2. **Separate FP32 read selection from write destination.**  
   [Network](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-2a9e2016/src/common/uct_tensorrt.cpp:305) still uses the driver-bound key, and its later `QSaveFile(path)` makes a simple path substitution dangerous. Root should use `Fp32PlanKey` for the stable destination and `LegacyFp32PlanKey` solely for explicit read-only lookup when stable is absent. Loading legacy bytes must create no stable copy; failed legacy loading must never overwrite the legacy file. Also resolve fresh-build identity: a newer builder must not write under an identity claiming builder `11.4.0.106`. Keep cached-runtime admission separate from builder preparation until that binding is explicit.

3. **Test absent-only BF16 fallback at the actual failure point.**  
   Require stable precedence when both paths exist; missing stable may select only the exact reviewed `e596b8…` locator. Present-but-corrupt, empty, unreadable, directory or dangling-link stable paths must not select legacy. Unknown existence errors should fail closed. The current [artifact test](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-2a9e2016/tests/uct_paddle_tests.cpp:305) supplies a missing graph, so its `ReadPlan` exception occurs before plan validation. Add path-selection cases separately, then an authorized pinned-asset case for successful legacy reading and unchanged inventories.

4. **Keep builder identity and runtime provenance unambiguous.**  
   Schema-2 `tensorRtVersion`/`tensorRtSha256` must remain exact **builder** metadata bound to the reviewed plan; loaded-runtime values belong in provenance. Driver API integer and `nvcuda` build/hash must influence neither new keys nor approval equality. Test each provenance field independently, including unavailable file provenance, while retaining rejection for UUID, compute capability, source/config/dictionary/graph, precision/profile/ABI and plan changes. Do not recreate an approval gate through mandatory provenance hashing.

5. **Update diagnostic cache resolution alongside the root seam.**  
   [Resident `PlanKey`](/Z:/Projects/T3-worktrees/oku_flow/t3-2a9e2016/tests/uct_resident_diagnostic.hpp:418) duplicates the old algorithm; active and paused diagnostics consume it. Share the production lookup policy so stable-only, legacy-only and both-present inventories identify the same selected file and receipt. Preserve golden legacy keys for every supported batch/width profile.

Retain the earlier ownership requirements: test recognizer rejection after detector construction without publishing partial readiness; ordered-to-fixed fallback must commit both engines, identities, width, capacity and ABI together. Deserialization/API/context/CUDA faults, failed completion and post-work output faults must retire/quarantine without another precision attempt. Only typed pre-inference `ArtifactError` plus confirmed completion may advance an approved fallback pair.
